previousSelection.selectionBasis: The then-current replay had subsequently caught up after the bounded diagnostics; the selected method itself was measured during active replay with a positive backlog at both window boundaries. No idle result is used as actual-replay evidence.

selectedMethod.selectionBasis: Selected after the user set a 1.5–4.0 second guest replica DATA read-await target. The 4-worker active-replay calibration was 1353.711 ms, below the lower bound. The 5-worker active-replay calibration was 1675.935 ms across 15/15 intervals (91.110s, all intervals at least 1500 ms and none above 2000 ms), with positive replay backlog at both ends, replay advancement and DATA write progress; it is the selected bounded treatment. The earlier 16-worker full attempt measured 7404.765 ms over the whole observed window and was stopped at the user ceiling, preserved as an incomplete diagnostic.
